correctness.rationale: For complement a->3-a on four letters, forbidden windows have form (a,b,bar b,bar a). The 64-state order-three de Bruijn graph has allowed edges precisely when the length-four window is not forbidden. Labeled circular words of every n>=1, including periodic extension when n<4, biject with traced closed walks tr(A^n). Recomputed A independently and verified its entire degree-64 characteristic polynomial by exact integer symbolic factorization: x^36(x-1)^3(x+1)^3(x^2+1)^2 times the displayed cubic, squared quintic and companion quintic. Therefore det(I-zA)=Q(z) and formal determinant log gives exact zeta and all length traces. Burnside and Moebius give cyclic/primitive orbits; direct independent enumeration n=1..6 matches traces. The output does not claim physical duplication removal at n<4. Spectral dominance comes from isolated roots of the displayed polynomial; trace identity valid without numerical root approximations.
